content:
The municipal government of Nuevo Laredo will deploy a special prevention and surveillance operation tonight, Saturday, October 31, to protect families heading out for Halloween.

The operation brings together the Traffic and Roadway Department, the Municipal Guard, Civil Protection and Firefighters, who will run patrols and hold a preventive presence at strategic points across the city.

Surveillance points announced by Civil Protection and Fire director Humberto Fernández Diez de Pinos include the intersection of Doctor Mier and Guerrero streets; Guerrero and Héroe de Nacataz; and the area around the Infonavit roundabout in the Infonavit Fundadores neighborhood.

The goal, according to the municipal government, is to safeguard pedestrian traffic from families taking part in traditional Halloween rounds and to reduce roadway risks during the celebration.

To report a risk or request help during the festivities, residents can call 911. The direct line for Civil Protection and Firefighters is 867 712 8911.

Authorities said safety recommendations will keep being published through the official digital platforms of Civil Protection and the municipal government until the festivities conclude.

What to watch

Halloween night is one of the busiest pedestrian nights of the year on both sides of the river. The checkpoint list gives families a map of where help will already be posted — and a reminder that the quickest call in an emergency is still 911.

Sources:

  • La Voz NLD, "Nuevo Laredo prepara operativo especial por Halloween," October 27, 2026

title: Nuevo Laredo deploys Halloween safety operation tonight: checkpoints, patrols and emergency numbers
